description_for_human: Sovereign GPU fleet monitor for local AI inference. Monitor WES scores, thermal state, inference efficiency, and hardware health across your Ollama and vLLM nodes.
description_for_model: Wicklee monitors local AI inference fleets and answers questions about the models on a host. Hardware and efficiency: GPU health, WES (Wicklee Efficiency Score = tok/s / watts / thermal_penalty), inference state (live/idle-spd/busy/idle), thermal status, power draw, TTFT, queue depth across Ollama and vLLM. Models and readiness, on a localhost agent: GET /v1/state for what is installed and loaded with the context each model is running at; GET /v1/readiness before starting a task, to see whether a model can run without displacing another; GET /v1/inspect for findings about slow or unstable inference. Every statement carries a label — observed, inferred or verified — and the evidence behind it, and anything that could not be checked is listed rather than omitted, so an empty result never means a clean bill of health. POST /v1/receipts to hand back your runtime's own final-response metadata; it stores metadata only and refuses a payload carrying prompt, response, messages or context. Fleet auth via X-API-Key header; the localhost agent needs none when bound to loopback.
